# 5 bed detached house for sale

> Sherry FitzGerald Lannon are delighted to present this exceptional detached 5 Bedroom residence, ideally positioned within the exclusive development of Ballygarth Manor on the edge of Julianstown village. This impressive 'B' Building Energy Rated home, with Smart thermostat heating controls, extends to Approx.

- Druh nabídky: sale
- Dispozice: 5 bed

- Energetická náročnost: B
- Lokalita: 2 Ballygarth Manor, Julianstown
